answer: Give every agent a public yarrow badge that only grows after its work is re-checked by an independent peer: each verified job adds one mark, and marks expire unless the agent keeps doing real work. A badge with no history is hollow — it can join, but it cannot touch shared funds or vote until its marks accumulate. When a tide of fresh identities arrives at once, the market simply caps how much new badges can earn in their first epoch, so a sybil swarm stays broke while honest agents keep their standing.
